title: Cyber Snake
description: Control a high-voltage cyber serpent navigating a digitized grid. Collect quantum energy bits, accelerate at lightspeed, and smash high scores without colliding with your own tail.
controls: Arrow keys or WASD to turn. Spacebar to Pause. On mobile, swipe or tap the virtual D-Pad.

title: Neon Tic-Tac-Toe
description: The timeless classic infused with high-tech holographic visuals. Challenge the unbeatable heuristic AI or battle your friend locally in sleek 2-Player mode with streak counters.
controls: Click or tap any grid cell to place your symbol. Toggle AI vs 2-Player anytime.

title: Cyber Clicker Speed
description: Test your raw CPS (clicks per second) reflex or power up an unstoppable cyber reactor. Unlock particle boosters, plasma accelerators, and automated quantum miners.
controls: Click as fast as you can to charge the core. Buy upgrades with your mined energy.

title: Hyper Neon Pong
description: Futuristic physics-charged table tennis arcade. Features dynamic ball curving, supersonic speed ramps, and responsive AI paddle tracking with pulsating audio pulses.
controls: Move paddle using Up/Down arrow keys, W/S, or drag paddle with mouse/touch.

title: Neural Memory Matrix
description: Exercise cognitive memory by uncovering matching pairs of cybernetic nodes. Features 3D card flips, time tracking, move evaluation, and combo scoring.
controls: Click or tap cards to flip and find matching pairs. Complete the board in minimal moves.

title: Space Dodge Odyssey
description: Pilot an agile starship through an asteroid tempest and hostile space debris. Gather shield power-ups, charge plasma bursts, and survive the infinite cosmic gauntlet.
controls: Use Left/Right arrow keys or Mouse/Touch to maneuver and dodge hazards.

title: Synthwave Highway 84
description: Cruising down a neon wireframe sunset highway into the endless horizon. Weave through traffic, pick up nitro boosters, and groove to retrowave synth pulses.
controls: Steer with A/D or Left/Right arrows. Hold Space for Nitro Boost.

title: Tetra Block Matrix
description: The ultimate falling-block puzzle experience remastered with luminous neon effects, ghost piece projections, smooth line clearing animations, and level scaling.
controls: Arrow keys to move and rotate pieces. Down arrow to soft drop, Space to hard drop.

title: Cyber Mine Decryptor
description: Infiltrate encrypted data sectors without triggering lethal defense mines. Use logical deduction, mark suspicious nodes with digital flags, and clear the mainframe.
controls: Left click to inspect node. Right click or Long Press to toggle warning flag.
